title: To God the Only Wise
description: To God the Only Wise in Tonic Solfa to FRANCONIA, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book I, collected from the Scriptures, hymn 51, headed “Persevering grace, Jude 24 25”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to FRANCONIA; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: To God the on-ly wise, Our Sa-viour and our King, Let all the saints be-low the skies Their hum-ble prais-es bring.

lines: Let all the saints below the skies
Preserves us safe from sin and death,
Before the glory of his face,
Shall bless the conduct of his grace,

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to FRANCONIA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
